title: Raid figures fight smarter
lines: In The Little Raid, a heal or shield now waits until a friend it reaches is at 85% health or less, an area ability that would hit only 1 of 3 or more enemies waits up to 1 second for a second one, and figures stop aiming at an enemy that what is already flying at it will fell.

Twelve figures' abilities now move, linger or channel: the Dusk Jay dashes, Greg jumps into the crowd, Crab #40 pulls, the Reed Heron marks its line before it stabs, the Slug, Drizzle Frog and Moth leave slime, puddles and dust, and the Kettle and Cinder Newt pour and breathe over 1 second. Each card says what changed.
